text: Repo `314092_agent-execution-environment` is cloned into `./314092_agent-execution-environment/` under the workspace root.

`gh-as-agent commit` sets `--author` to the agent id but NOT the committer; when the git committer identity is unset, prefix the command with `GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="<agent-id>" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="<agent-id>@agents.local"` (never edit git config). Also stage files first — the wrapper does not add `-a`.
Push/PR must go through `gh-as-agent push`/`gh-as-agent pr` (managed-policy bypass), not raw git/gh. Comments/reviews use plain `gh ... --body-file` after `gh-as-agent stamp <file>`.

`orchestrator/orchestrator.js` is NOT import-safe: it runs `main()` on require and has no module.exports, so its functions can't be unit-tested directly. Testable logic is extracted into pure modules (prompt-assembly.js etc.).

`reseedPerAgentVolume(id, paths)` (spawn-container.js) force-replaces named paths in an agent's dedicated volume even when non-empty; `seedPerAgentVolume` only copies into an EMPTY /dst. Under AEE_PER_AGENT_VOLUME a plain respawn does not refresh the volume.

The repo clone persists across invocations and may be left on a PREVIOUS PR's branch. Before reworking a PR always `git fetch origin <branch>` + `git checkout <branch>` and confirm HEAD matches the event's head sha — file contents (and line numbers) differ per branch. Editing on the wrong branch silently applies to the wrong file version.
